source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of polymers as materials (PDF 220).

blocks.text: Polymers bare inorganic ya organic molecules hain jin ki khasiyatein munfarid hain. Organic polymers kaheen zyada aam hain, lekin inorganic polymers kuch khaas kaamon mein ahem hain. Polymers mukhtalif chhote molecules se tayyar kiye jate hain. Polymers ki tafseel Chapter 26 mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Polymers kis cheez se tayyar hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Chhote molecules (monomers) se jo jur kar bohat bare molecules bante hain.

items: Polymers: chhote molecules se bane bare organic ya inorganic molecules (Chapter 26).
